title: Control Constructs: Tether/Chains, Restraining Bands (extension to construct core)
description:
Purpose: Add control constructs beyond the core: Chain/Tether (reel or anchor), Restraining Bands (stacking slows), enhanced Energy Cage behaviours. Integrates with promoted.ring_construct_core selection wheel under Control category.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- Left Trigger: Secondary ability / target assist / contextual support action can refine lock.
- Right Trigger: Confirm spawn/engage of selected control construct.
- Left Grip: May guide tether vector on re-aim.

Params (params_json):
- tether_max_length_m (float, default 18.0)
- tether_tension_break_threshold (float, default 1.0) normalized
- reel_in_speed_mps (float, default 2.0)
- bands_slow_per_stack (float, default 0.18)
- bands_max_stacks (int, default 3)
- fear_zone_resistance_multiplier (float, default 1.5) increases break chance in yellow zones

Behaviour:
1) Tether/Chain:
   - On Right Trigger, cast a fast chain projectile (uses construct_chain_tether asset) toward the Left Trigger refined target if present, else reticle target. On hit, create a tether joint between player anchor (or world anchor) and target entity. Show tension lines; update tension from relative velocity and distance.
   - Left Trigger held: switch to reel/anchor mode. Reel-in pulls target toward player at reel_in_speed_mps; anchor mode clamps target to a point on surfaces.
   - Over-tension: if normalized tension > threshold considering fear_zone_resistance_multiplier in yellow zones, break the tether with a snap VFX.
2) Restraining Bands:
   - On activation, apply a debuff to target: each stack reduces target max speed by bands_slow_per_stack, visualized by ring-like bands from construct_chain_tether material. Stacks decay over time or when target is not engaged.
3) Enhanced Cage:
   - If Energy Cage (from core) is active and player re-aims at same target, Left Trigger tightens the cage (reduces radius slightly, increases drain marginally) and extends duration.

Components:
- Reads: target highlights from construct core, CTransform, CPhysics, zone tags (yellow energy), enemy tags.
- Writes: CTetherJoint (custom), CStatusEffect (slow stacks), VFX spawn events, resource drain requests to ring_energy API (promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge).

Comfort/safety:
- Tethers exert capped forces to avoid camera yanks; impulse on player side is softened with damping. No abrupt camera movement.

Acceptance hooks:
- Satisfies test_tether_and_cage_control: tether a drone, pull to cover, then cage a ground enemy for >=3s.

Integration:
- Registers new Control entries with promoted.ring_construct_core by name ids: "chain_tether" and "restraining_bands".
- Uses assets: construct_chain_tether and construct_cage.

Scenes:
- asteroid_mining_outpost, fear_corrupted_ruins.

Suggested file split: control_constructs_register.cpp, control_tether.cpp, control_bands.cpp, control_integration_core.cpp.
